name: Knockdown
body:
Discipline: psychokinesis; Level: Marksman 2

MANIFESTING

Display: mental, olfactory
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: see text
Target: One creature
Duration: instantaneous
Saving Throw: Reflex negates; see text; Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 3

DESCRIPTION

As part of manifesting this power, you make a ranged attack with a ranged or thrown weapon against the target. If the attack hits, the target is knocked prone unless they succeed on a Reflex save.
